hints.title: Left to Right Processing
hints.text: The leftmost non-zero element must be decremented by operations starting right at its position.

hints.title: Difference Tracking
hints.text: Use a rolling sum or difference array to avoid modifying all k elements individually.

hints.title: Boundary Validation
hints.text: If reducing an element requires starting a window that goes past array bounds, reduction is impossible.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Difference array tracking active decrements across sliding windows of length k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Directly subtracting across k elements for every position takes O(n * k) which times out for large arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time and O(n) space using a difference array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply difference array technique to perform range updates in O(1) amortized time.
